Thank you all for flagging these issues before we proceed. Based on what I'm hearing, the current draft plan has four problems that need to be resolved before I can approve anything:

1. Leon, you're saying the city permit prohibits amplified sound on Harbor Roof, so we'd need to switch to silent playback with music added in post. Can you get that permit email shared with the rest of the team?

And the artist requires final cut approval, which means our ordinary editorial process isn't sufficient. Please upload that countersigned rider to the shared file today.

I can't approve this shoot plan as currently drafted. Once we have the revised plan incorporating all of these changes — silent playback, single-performer aerial rig with fall-arrest harness, no pyrotechnics, no visible alcohol branding, and artist final cut approval — along with the verbal signoffs from location, safety, and artist reps, I'll be able to move forward. Let's get these changes documented and circulate updated materials before we reconvene.
